computed style of the header Store link on https://www.dji.com/sg (raw/components-computed.json, home.store-button) Font size and weight are computed. The 16px line height is Derived from the 14px size plus the 8px vertical padding, not a stored line-height.

computed style of the Where To Buy h1 (raw/components-computed.json, whereToBuy.h1) Font size and weight are computed. The 36px line height is Derived; the reading stored the box height (76px) which includes padding.

computed style of the Support hero h1 (raw/components-computed.json, support.support-h1) Font size, weight and the 56px box height are computed. The line height equals that box height. White on a photograph, not a page ground.
